other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: buy signal closes short, sell signal closes long, gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose permissions

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative MM value (-0.1) = fixed lot size of 0.1 lots; positive MM value = deposit fraction for risk-based sizing. Logic handled in TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal uses bar index SignalBar=1 (previous completed bar) for the crossover check, comparing buffer values at index [1] vs [0] relative to SignalBar. The crossover logic: BUY_Open triggers when MPlus[1]>MMinus[1] (current state bullish) AND MPlus[0]<=MMinus[0] (prior state was bearish or neutral), confirming a fresh crossover. SELL_Open uses inverse logic. Signal is only evaluated on new bar arrival or on first bar (SignalBar==0). The Recount flag ensures signal recalculation if CopyBuffer fails. Signal time is set to the last bar datetime plus one period for trade expiration context. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen and BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are boolean permission gates allowing independent control of entry and exit directions.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorMETRO custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it appears to be an RSI-based step-filter indicator with fast (5) and slow (15) step sizes. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles position opening/closing with SL/TP assignment and must be replicated. The crossover detection uses a 2-bar lookback relative to SignalBar: index [1] is the signal bar and [0] is the bar before it (since SignalBar=1 by default). Position sizing logic is conditional on the sign of MM input: negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction. No digit adjustment is applied to SL/TP values, but verify whether 1000/2000 pips are truly pips or points (likely points, meaning 10 pips SL / 20 pips TP for 5-digit brokers).
